Maya (PM): Quick async check — please drop one-line updates for your OKR milestones this quarter: what shipped, what slid, blockers, owner + next action ETA. Im rolling this up for Friday shiproom, cc @team
Sam (Eng): Search indexing milestone: shipped v1 API + docs yesterday. Canary at 10% in prod, perf looks good. Next: scale testing for wide queries — I own, ETA Tue 3/18.
Priya (Eng): Vector store integration slipped — blocked by quantization diff in runtime. Root cause looks like KV-cache misalignment on 8-bit path. Need infra help to repro.
Oliver (Infra): On it — Ill try to reproduce with a minimal repro. @Priya can you paste exact model + quant config?
Priya (Eng): Sent stack + config to the thread: model=redwood-13b-q4, quant=8bit-gptq, batch=8. Repro command: ```./run_repro --model redwood-13b-q4 --quant 8bit-gptq --batch 8```
Jordan (Eng-Prod): UI rollout: feature flag on for 20% web. Shipping analytics event missing for the a11y path — my bad. Fix PR out, needs 1 reviewer.
Sam (Eng): Ill review Jordan's PR today. @Jordan please add the trace_id field in the event payload so we can tie errors back to requests.
Maya (PM): Dependencies note: who needs dedicated infra / freeze window? Any SLA items to flag? Finance needs Dedicated numbers by EOD Thu.
Alex (SRE): Dedicated infra request: search scale tests will need +2 vGPU nodes Wed-Thu. Filing ticket now: INF-2458.
Priya (Eng): If infra cant repro by EOD, plan B is to roll back the quantized path and ship a soft-feature with a note in the release.
Maya (PM): Owners for rollup pls confirm by EOD: Sam (search), Priya (vector), Jordan (UI), Alex (infra). Ill compile for shiproom.
deploy-bot: staging-deploy: build 20260317.3 triggered by @ci — status: success.
Sam (Eng): Canary results: monitoring shows a 1.2% error-rate bump on the long tail. Investigating timeout handling and retries.
Oliver (Infra): Looks like client retry loops are amplifying tail latency. Adding a circuit-breaker patch to infra queue.
Maya (PM): Thanks all — drop a single-line final update before 6pm so I can paste into the shiproom notes. :thumbsup:
